exposure: maternal alpha-fetoprotein multiple of the median (MoM)
outcome: age of the first central deciduous tooth eruption
cohort: The study included 151 children aged 12 to 27 months from Isfahan City, Iran.
finding: The study found a potential inverse linear association between maternal alpha-fetoprotein levels (especially MoM) and the eruption timing of the first primary tooth, particularly in preterm infants.
cross-section timing: When children were aged 12 to 27 months
gest_age: Includes both full-term and preterm children.
